title: Applique Sequin Ruffle Sleeve Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your special occasion in our Applique Sequin Ruffle Sleeve Mother of the Bride Dress! This stunning gown features delicate ruffle sleeves adorned with shimmering sequins, creating a captivating look. The elegant silhouette and intricate appliqu??¨¬| details ensure you shine as you celebrate love and family.


Size Tips: Prioritize selecting based on bust and waist measurements.
The upper body features high elasticity, and the elastic waistband can be stretched by at least 2 inches.

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
